spec: §9.1 (as amended — ruling S440 all recs #2 item 4), §65.5
rationale: R4: a `#{}` in a plain (non-component) element is PROGRAM-GLOBAL — no scope: its `.x` rule styles an `.x` OUTSIDE the element that holds it, its descendant rule reaches a `section` elsewhere on the page; blocks inside an `if=` element and inside an `<each>` row are global too. §65.5: a component's own scoped `.x` (unlayered) beats the global `.x` (`@layer global`).
